blocks.text: Status: CANONICAL — USABLE LOCAL PRODUCT RELEASE

The local browser workbench and JSON API expose conservative general-English analysis, deterministic candidate ranking, visible ambiguity reasons, explicit runtime/speech-act/role resolution, controlled-English compilation, Semantic IR and EZF-1 inspection, accessible SVG notation, reference-tone preview, and Standard MIDI export. The default server binds only to 127.0.0.1 and sends no telemetry.

The EZB-1 exchange bundle stores source input, selected sense and target, controlled form, Semantic IR, EZF-1, and presentation hashes under one deterministic SHA-256 envelope. Imports verify the bundle digest, exact IR/EZF round trip, and SVG/MIDI manifests before acceptance.

The product corpus contains 84 reviewed indexed-sense cases and 13 curated end-to-end journeys. The canonical release passes 15 of 15 product checks, JavaScript syntax validation, a real localhost HTTP smoke test, and the complete historical regression across all semantic families and all seven translator-readiness gates. Browser QA verified ambiguity handling, explicit resolution, controlled compilation, keyboard selection, mode isolation, and presentation views; one stale-view defect was found and corrected before promotion.

Product release 1.0 changes no atomic meaning, generated form, approved compound, indexed sense route, etymology, Semantic IR rule, or renderer identity. Authority remains 324 canonical atoms, 28 approved compounds, 436 indexed senses, and 11 explicit vocabulary gaps. The application is a safe, auditable interface to that authority rather than a claim of exhaustive English coverage.
